analysis.morphology: Conjunction וְ prefixed to an independent second-person masculine singular pronoun.
analysis.sense: you, as for you (the one addressed set apart)

analysis.evidence: אֶל־אֲבֹתֶיךָ gives the destination, “to your fathers.” The following תִּקָּבֵר, “you will be buried,” shows that going to his fathers in peace refers to Abram’s death.
analysis.morphology: Qal imperfect, second person masculine singular, with future reference. The explicit subject אַתָּה identifies Abram as the addressee.

analysis.evidence: In תָּבוֹא אֶל אֲבֹתֶיךָ, “you will go to your fathers,” אֶל introduces the goal of תָּבוֹא. The following תִּקָּבֵר, “you will be buried,” places the promise in the context of Abram’s death.
analysis.morphology: Hebrew preposition without a prefix or suffix.
analysis.sense: Marks the people toward whom someone goes.

analysis.evidence: Abram is told he will go to his ancestors in peace. The following promise, “you will be buried at a good old age,” identifies them as his deceased forebears.
analysis.morphology: Masculine plural construct of אָב with a second-person masculine singular possessive suffix referring to Abram.

analysis.evidence: בְּשָׁלוֹם describes how Abram will go to his ancestors. The parallel promise that he will be buried בְּשֵׂיבָה טוֹבָה, “at a good old age,” supports the reading of a peaceful death.
analysis.morphology: The preposition בְּ marks manner and governs a masculine singular absolute noun.
analysis.sense: Safety from harm as Abram comes to the end of his life.

analysis.evidence: The explicit subject וְאַתָּה, “and you,” identifies Abram as the addressee. After the promise that he will go to his fathers in peace, תִּקָּבֵר בְּשֵׂיבָה טוֹבָה promises that he will be buried at a good old age.
analysis.morphology: Niphal imperfect, second person masculine singular. The form is passive and expresses a future promise to Abram.

analysis.evidence: תִּקָּבֵר בְּשֵׂיבָה טוֹבָה means “you will be buried at a good old age.” The phrase describes Abram’s age at burial and accords with the promise that he will go to his ancestors in peace.
analysis.morphology: The preposition בְּ marks the time of burial. The common noun שֵׂיבָה is feminine singular absolute and agrees with the following adjective טוֹבָה.

analysis.evidence: In בְּשֵׂיבָה טוֹבָה, “at a good old age,” טוֹבָה describes the old age at which Abram will be buried. The preceding בְּשָׁלוֹם, “in peace,” reinforces the favorable sense.
analysis.morphology: Feminine singular absolute adjective agreeing with שֵׂיבָה.
analysis.sense: good in quality, fine, fit for use
